question:
Simplify:

30 ÷ (40 ÷ 2² × 10 ÷ 5) × 6 - 4
solution:
**Given:**

30 ÷ (40 ÷ 2² × 10 ÷ 5) × 6 - 4

**Calculations:**

30 ÷ (40 ÷ 4 × 10 ÷ 5) × 6 - 4

⇒ 30 ÷ (10 × 2) × 6 - 4

⇒ 30 ÷ 20 × 6 - 4

⇒ 30/20 × 6 - 4

⇒ 3/2 × 6 - 4

⇒ 9 - 4 = 5

**∴ The simplified value of the given equation is 5.**
